scripts.check: node scripts/check.mjs && npm run check:lint && npm run check:format && npm run check:inline-usage && npm run check:web-inline-zero && npm run check:canonical-boundaries && npm run check:canonical-fonts
scripts.check:quick: npm run check:lint && npm run check:format
scripts.qa:release: npm run check:feature && npm run test:coverage
scripts.check:ci: npm run check && npm run test:unit && npm run build
scripts.check:ui: npm run build && npm run test:e2e:ui-guards
scripts.verify:web:e2e: npm run build:web && playwright test -c playwright.web.config.ts --workers=1
scripts.verify:admin:e2e: npm run build:admin && playwright test -c playwright.admin.config.ts --workers=1
scripts.verify:bridge: npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.admin.config.ts tests/admin/waitlist.spec.ts --workers=1
scripts.verify:merge: npm run check:feature && npm run test:coverage
scripts.test:e2e:admin: playwright test -c playwright.admin.config.ts tests/admin/architecture.spec.ts tests/admin/backlog.spec.ts tests/admin/business.spec.ts tests/admin/packs.spec.ts tests/admin/waitlist.spec.ts tests/admin/wording.spec.ts --workers=1
scripts.test:brand-system: npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.admin.config.ts tests/admin/design/brand-system.spec.ts
scripts.test:layout: npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.web.config.ts tests/web/home-layout.spec.ts --workers=1 && playwright test -c playwright.admin.config.ts tests/admin/design/brand-system.spec.ts --workers=1
scripts.test:legacy-parity: npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.web.config.ts tests/web/visual-compare.spec.ts
scripts.test:visual: npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.web.config.ts && playwright test -c playwright.admin.config.ts
scripts.test:visual:headed: npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.web.config.ts --headed && playwright test -c playwright.admin.config.ts --headed
